brief.topic: Three layers of LLM evaluation every team needs
brief.audience: PMs and engineers setting up LLM evaluation

coreInsight: Use three evaluation layers (code checks for exact rules, rubric grading for judgement calls, human review of real samples) because each catches failures the others miss.

hooks.text: Which eval would catch a rude answer?

caption.opening: A test suite that only checks format will happily pass a correct, rude, made-up answer.
body:
Three layers of evaluation:
→ Code checks: format, length, banned words, broken links. Run on every change.
→ Rubric grading: correct, grounded, on tone? Run before every release.
→ Human review: a weekly sample of real conversations.
Each layer is more expensive than the last. When humans keep finding the same problem, turn it into a check or a rubric line.

claims.text: Effective LLM evaluation combines deterministic checks, rubric-based grading and human review of real samples, because each catches different failures.
